rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for denying that a statement is true or valid.

example.traditional: 佢否認嗰篇報道嘅講法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fau2 jing6 go2 pin1 bou3 dou6 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when actively arguing against what another person has said.

example.english: They immediately contradict what the other person says.
example.traditional: 佢即刻反駁對方嘅講法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zik1 hak1 faan2 bok3 deoi3 fong1 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when two statements, facts, or things conflict with each other rather than when a person directly denies something.

example.english: These two claims contradict each other.
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 gong2 faat3 wu6 soeng1 maau4 teon5
